label: 'CEO' demands help-desk credential reset
narration: A privileged-action attack: not a payment, a credential reset — with every pressure lever attached.
raw_text_or_transcript:
[Phone call — transcribed]

Caller: Kabir, it's Vikram Shah. I'm locked out before the board call. Reset my MFA and password right now — full reset, not a temporary unlock. My assistant will verify on my behalf, so don't call back on the registered number. Don't log a ticket, and keep it quiet until the board call is done. I cannot wait for the usual verification queue.
